bfs_query: MATCH (g:Concept) CALL algo.bfs(g,1590,'REQUIRES') YIELD nodes RETURN g.id,[n IN nodes | n.id]
normalization: Add source concept; zero-descendant sources get singleton closures. Max depth 1590 covers any simple path in this validated 1590-concept DAG.
scope: Five warm local read runs per query, not end-to-end latency or evidence of superior teaching.
